title: Interpersonal state space schema
description: Generic schema for describing the state space(s) of a formal model of interpersonal dynamics.

unitOfAnalysis.description: Defines the unit of analysis for the model. In a monadic model, each agent has its own state space. In a dyadic model, the dyad has a shared state space.

stateSpaces.description: List of state spaces contained in the model. Each entry must be either a continuous or a discrete state space.

oneOf.title: Continuous state space
oneOf.description: A continuous state space with one or more dimensions and a shared mathematical range for all dimensions.

dimensionRange.description: Mathematical range that applies to each dimension of this continuous state space, for example all real numbers, greater than zero, or greater than or equal to zero.

lower.description: Lower boundary of the dimension range, e.g.:  "value": 0, "inclusive": true.

upper.description: Upper boundary of the dimension range, e.g.: "value": "infinity", "inclusive": false.

dimensions.description: List of dimensions that define this continuous state space.

items.description: A single dimension of the continuous state space.

abbreviation.description: Short abbreviation of the dimension. Only uppercase and lowercase ASCII letters are allowed, without whitespace, numbers, or special characters.

description.description: Textual explanation of what this dimension represents.

constraints.description: Mathematical constraints that apply to valid state vectors in this continuous state space.

oneOf.title: Discrete state space
oneOf.description: A discrete state space defined by a finite set of possible states.

states.description: List of discrete states that define this discrete state space.

abbreviation.description: Short abbreviation of the discrete state. Only uppercase and lowercase ASCII letters are allowed, without whitespace, numbers, or special characters.

description.description: Textual explanation of what this discrete state represents.

rangeBoundary.title: Range boundary
rangeBoundary.description: A lower or upper boundary of a mathematical range. The value can be a finite number or an infinity marker.

value.description: Boundary value. Use a number for finite boundaries, '-infinity' for negative infinity, or 'infinity' for positive infinity.

inclusive.description: Whether the boundary value is included in the range. For infinity boundaries this should normally be false.

stateSpaceConstraint.title: State space constraint
stateSpaceConstraint.description: A mathematical constraint that applies to valid state vectors in a continuous state space.

oneOf.title: Sum equals constraint
oneOf.description: Specifies that the values of selected dimensions must sum to a fixed numeric value.

type.description: Identifies this constraint as a sum-equals constraint.

dimensions.description: List of dimension abbreviations whose values must be summed.

value.description: Required numeric sum of the selected dimension values.
